text.en: People often call Canada a land of immigrants.
text.fr: On appelle souvent le Canada une terre d'immigration.

source.quote: Canada is often referred to as a land of immigrants

verification.evidence: However, Canada is often referred to as a land of immigrants because, over the past 200 years, millions of newcomers have helped to build and defend our way of life.

text.en: Most Canadians say they are Christians.
text.fr: La plupart des Canadiens se disent chrétiens.

source.quote: The great majority of Canadians identify as Christians.

text.en: The Catholic Church is the largest religious group in Canada. Next come the different Protestant churches.
text.fr: L'Église catholique est le plus grand groupe religieux au Canada. Viennent ensuite les différentes Églises protestantes.

source.quote: The largest religious affiliation is Catholic, followed by various Protestant churches.

text.en: In Canada, government and faith communities have a long habit of working together.
text.fr: Au Canada, l'État et les communautés religieuses ont depuis longtemps l'habitude de travailler ensemble.

source.quote: In Canada the state has traditionally partnered with faith communities

verification.evidence: In Canada the state has traditionally partnered with faith communities to promote social welfare, harmony and mutual respect; to provide schools and health care; to resettle refugees; and to uphold religious freedom, religious expression and freedom of conscience.

text.en: Gay and lesbian Canadians are part of the country's diversity.
text.fr: Les Canadiennes et les Canadiens gais et lesbiennes font partie de la diversité du pays.

source.quote: Canada’s diversity includes gay and lesbian Canadians

verification.evidence: Canada’s diversity includes gay and lesbian Canadians, who enjoy the full protection of and equal treatment under the law, including access to civil marriage.
